description_en: Calls ModifyInstanceServiceConfig to modify cluster configurations. You can call the ListInstanceServiceConfigurations operation to query the configuration items that can be modified
description_zh: 调用ModifyInstanceServiceConfig更改集群配置，可修改的配置项可通过ListInstanceServiceConfigurations接口查看
name: ModifyInstanceServiceConfig

parameters.help_en: The ID of target instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144595.html operation to obtain target instance ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to restart the instance after the configuration is modified. Valid values:

true: Restart the instance.
false: Do not restart the instance
parameters.help_zh:
更改配置项后是否需要重启实例，取值：

true：重启。
false：不重启
parameters.name: restart

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The name of the configuration item to modify. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201980.html operation to query the configuration item name.</props>
<props="intl">The name of the configuration item to modify.</props>

If you want to modify multiple configuration items, specify the Parameters parameter
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">待修改的配置项名称，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201980.html接口查看。</props>
<props="intl">待修改的配置项名称。</props>

如果您需要修改多个配置项，请输入Parameters参数
parameters.name: configure_name

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The value of the configuration item to modify. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201980.html operation to query the configuration item value.</props>
<props="intl">The value of the configuration item to modify.</props>

If you want to modify multiple configuration items, specify the Parameters parameter
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">待修改的配置项值，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201980.html接口查看。</props>
<props="intl">待修改的配置项值。</props>

如果您需要修改多个配置项，请输入Parameters参数
parameters.name: configure_value

parameters.help_en: The JSON-formatted parameters for modifying multiple configuration items. The key specifies the name of the configuration item, and the value specifies the value of the configuration item
parameters.help_zh: 如果需要修改多个配置项，可以在该参数里配置JSON参数。key表示配置项的名称，value表示配置项的值
parameters.name: parameters
